title: Flowmoro
headline: Master your productivity.
lead: A simple, minimalist Pomodoro timer for iPhone and Android. One timer, one button, and nothing else on the screen.

tour.title: Stay focused
tour.text: An uncluttered interface that keeps you on the task in front of you.
tour.alt: Flowmoro timer at 9:56 with a blue fill and a single pause button

tour.title: Custom sessions
tour.text: Set work length, break length, and the number of sessions to fit how you work.
tour.alt: Flowmoro settings sliders for total, work, break, and session count

tour.title: Simple theming
tour.text: Pick a theme color from the palette.
tour.alt: Flowmoro theme color picker with a grid of colors

tour.title: Themes for your style
tour.text: The timer, controls, and fill all follow the color you pick.
tour.alt: Flowmoro timer at 9:46 in an indigo theme

tour.title: Warm or cool
tour.text: Switch colors any time from settings.
tour.alt: Flowmoro timer at 10:09 in a coral theme

tour.title: Dark mode
tour.text: A clean dark mode for late sessions.
tour.alt: Flowmoro timer at 10:29 in dark mode with an orange fill

closing.title: No account. No tracking.
closing.text: Flowmoro does not collect or share any data. Notifications stay on your device.
